title: AI Intern – Vision-Language-Action (VLA) & Data
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR, part of Amazon developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery.

Important Notice: For this position, we can unfortunately only accept applications from citizens of Schengen Area countries. This restriction does not apply to ETHZ and EPFL students who are required to complete compulsory internships as part of their studies.

Job Description

As an AI Intern - VLA & Data, you will assist the AI engineering team in developing data pipelines and training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic systems. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of data engineering and model training, assisting the team in solving the "data bottleneck" in embodied AI. Additionally, your responsibilities will include building tools to analyze datasets, visualize model predictions, and debug performance. You will work closely with senior engineers to understand, curate, and visualize the massive amounts of multi-modal data our fleet generates. This role offers hands-on experience within a dynamic and collaborative environment. We are committed to finding and nurturing exceptional talent; our internships are a key pathway to recruiting outstanding graduates who can make a significant impact in our team.


What you’ll be doing

  • Support the team in processing, curating, and analyzing multi-modal sensor data for training VLA models.

  • Get hands-on experience with state-of-the-art VLA models.

  • Assist in developing software tools to visualize data and debug model performance.

  • Work closely with senior engineers to implement data strategies that improve the robustness of our robotic systems.

  • Help integrate software components to evaluate algorithms in simulation and on hardware.

  • Engage in continuous learning and gain exposure to recent developments in VLA, self-supervised learning, and generative AI.


    • What you must have

  • At least BSc in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks (preferably PyTorch).

  • Hands-on experience (either through coursework, previous internships, or other projects) with deep learning for computer vision.

  • Familiarity with data manipulation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, OpenCV).

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an eagerness to work with complex, real-world data.

  • Eagerness to learn and contribute in a collaborative team environment.


    • Get some bonus points

  • An MSc or ongoing PhD in a related field.

  • Previous experience working with large-scale image or video datasets.

  • Knowledge or experience with transformers, Vision-Language Models and/or VLA’s.

  • Experience with 3D geometry, camera projections, or sensor fusion.

  • Experience working with robotic systems

  • Experience in motion/action prediction in robotics context.

    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
     
    We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

This role is both highly technical and operationally strategic: you’ll design and maintain automation workflows, manage key processes (admissions, education, career services, billing), and ensure data accuracy across all areas.

title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: Working Student – People & Office Operations (60%)
description:
About us

Omnilex started by building the AI workspace lawyers actually want to use, including the world's first AI-powered legal commentary, a living layer of legal understanding that redefines how lawyers work. In just one year, that product became the daily tool of thousands of legal professionals across Switzerland, Germany, and Liechtenstein, and a leading legal AI workspace in those markets.

Now we are using that foundation to build something even bigger: the AI-native law firm. Every case our lawyers solve becomes a productized, AI-native service. Legal capability that scales, compounds, and can be deployed on demand for the next client. With a 4.5M raise, we're scaling internationally. You'll be joining a young, passionate, and dynamic team of 17.

The role

You are the person who keeps the office running, the hiring pipeline moving, and the team feeling like a team.

You will work side by side with our Chief of Staff, our recruiter, and the founders, with real ownership from week one. Close enough to see how decisions actually get made at a company at this stage, and to be part of making them.

And you will learn HR and Talent at the point where it is being rebuilt. AI is not a side topic here; it is what we build. You will use it daily in how we source, hire, and onboard, and you will learn what people operations looks like when it is designed around AI from the start.

Nobody expects you to walk in knowing it all – just bring curiosity and enthusiasm for figuring things out along the way.

What you will do

Recruiting

  • Research and identify candidates for our open roles

  • Run outreach end-to-end, from first message to booked interview

  • Keep our pipelines in Ashby accurate and current

  • Build reporting on our pipelines and help automate the parts of hiring that should not be manual

People and culture

  • Run onboarding for new joiners so their first week is a good one

  • Organise team events, dinners and offsite logistics

  • Look after birthdays, work anniversaries and the small things that add up

Office management

  • Keep the Zurich office running day-to-day: supplies, deliveries, post, meeting rooms

  • Be the point of contact for building management and our office suppliers

This list will not stay static. As you grow into the role, you will take on more across operations.

Who you are

  • You are in the office at least 3 days a week, Mondays included. We are flexible on which hours, as long as they are consistent

  • You are not afraid to reach out to people you don't know. Writing to a stranger is interesting to you, not intimidating

  • You gain energy from conversations. Talking to candidates and colleagues is the part of the job you would look forward to

  • You are structured and organised. What you own does not fall through the cracks

  • You are proactive. You notice what needs doing and do it without being asked

  • You want to build a career in HR or Talent and are looking for the place to start

  • Fluency in German and English. Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship

Bonus:

  • First experience in recruiting, HR, office management or events

  • Familiarity with an ATS (Ashby, Greenhouse, Personio) or Notion

  • You have built something with AI, not just used it. An automation, an agent, a workflow — tell us what it does

Why join Omnilex

  • You will own real scope from day one. This is not shadowing and not admin

  • You will learn recruiting hands-on, reporting directly to the Chief of Staff

  • You will see how a company scales from the inside, in a team that is growing fast internationally

  • Flexible hours around your studies or other commitments, with a clear path to more responsibility

title: AI Response Analyst
description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.
